output.explanation: Massachusetts has a state-level prohibition on rent control with limited exceptions under MA-RENT-01. Cambridge, as a city within Massachusetts, is preempted by state law from implementing independent rent increase limits. The available guidance documents (D029, D031) do not contain specific rent increase limit language, and link-only sources do not provide text evidence of a local rule. The state preemption rule MA-RENT-01 bars the jurisdiction from establishing this category of regulation.
